analysis.one_line_summary: A creator styles her curly frizzy hair with the Wavytalk thermal brush while explaining why fall is the best season for blowouts.
analysis.full_description: A young curly-haired woman sits in front of the camera with half of her hair styled in a sleek, bouncy blowout and the other half naturally curly and frizzy. While demonstrating how she uses the light-blue Wavytalk thermal blowout brush to smooth and flip her hair, she addresses criticism from other curly girls about heat styling, explains why lower fall humidity makes blowouts easier and longer-lasting, and highlights the convenience of a heated round brush over a traditional round brush plus blow dryer. She promotes Wavytalk's seasonal sale, finishes styling her bangs and other side, and presents the glossy, voluminous final blowout result.

analysis.transcript_full_original: So many curly girls get so mad whenever I say that fall is for blowouts. However, it's not that I don't love my curly hair. I mean, God forbid a girl wants to switch it up sometime and have a nice, smooth, silky blowout instead of that! The reason you hear some people saying that fall is for blowouts, me included, is because the humidity is always less, or significantly less at least, in the fall, so it's so much easier to heat style curly hair. And this is because curly hair is always desperate for moisture. So when the humidity is down, it means that our hair won't go sucking up all the moisture. I use a thermal brush to do my blowouts just because I find it is way easier than holding a round brush and a hair dryer. That gets old really fast. And I just pull all the way down, and then once I get to the bottom, I like to give it a little curl at the ends just to have a little bit more volume down there. I mean, just look at the difference that we have so far. That is crazy! And hey, curly hair is for every season, and blowouts can also be for every season. However, they are definitely a lot easier in the fall and winter when there's not so much humidity outside. If you've been wanting to get your hands on this brush, Wavytalk is running their fall sale right now, so I highly recommend grabbing it while it's on sale before it goes back to full price. All right, and here's the finished hair. It looks so smooth and shiny. A thermal brush really is the key to an easy, quick blowout.
